page.running_head: De Agro Frif. ivter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: pulchritudinem ac fortunam pene posse adijci. Castella vero militaria in agri ora, Soltcampæum ad Hunefi ostium, Delfsi-laeum sæpe jam dictum, præ cæteris ingens, Reidanum in Amasi & Dullarti angulo communi, Bellingwoldium ad Dullarti recessum intimum, Buertangæum in palustribus inter Westerwoldios & Mo†nasterienses mediis, integra adhuc omnia, & præsidiis insessa ad servandos regionis aditus contra hostes : cætera complura jam exarmata.

Iurisdictio in Agro.Jurisdictio per omnem agrum (exce-pâ[?] Præfecturâ vetere, quæ ad civitatem, & Westerwoldiis[?], quæ ad Addingios, & ab his ad Arembergios certis legibus devoluta fuit, & territorio suburbano, cujus etiam peculiaris ratio) cum prædiis antiquitus liberis ac immunibus connexa est, ut qui prædia illa ut sua tenet, jurisdictionem cum imperio quoque teneat. Juris dicundi autem causa agri totius partes illæ jam expositæ in territoria quædam minora sunt subdivisæ. Et horum alia vicos singulos, alia binos, alia ternos quaternóïve[?] complectuntur ; quædam etiam

page.notes: Running head: the printed "iuter" was given as "ivter" under the u/v rule. The printed word may be "inter". The marginal note "Iurisdictio in Agro." is set in two lines beside the paragraph start. "pâ[?]" is an abbreviation mark that is unclear. "quaternóïve[?]" is unclear, possibly "quaternóive". The "†" in "Mo†nasterienses" is a worn letter, probably "n", so it is read here as a doubtful mark. The left-hand "4" under the text is treated as the signature. The faint mark at the bottom right, "Google" watermark, is a digitiser's mark and left out.
